The brief allows only sourcing corrections to agent files, so those values carry dated notes but are unchanged; removing them needs an agent revision round.
Modelling note, not a citation failure: Paycom's own FCF definition also deducts intangible-asset purchases (FY25 $4.5M); the $572.2M base, like StockAnalysis's $575.1M, leaves them out.
